objective: Implement and verify the first region-safe ROM-side NetBridge core on the pinned PokéCrossroads engine.
closed_decisions: The bridge uses independent ABI ordinals UNSPECIFIED=0, HOENN=1, KANTO=2, JOHTO=3, and SEVII=4; engine Region ordinals never cross the ABI.
Sevii is detected through GetKantoSubregion; playerRegion is not current location and generic badge flags are not regional progress.
WorldLocation widens map group and number to u16 and uses i16 coordinates with explicit conversion checks.
ABI version 1 uses magic 0x504B434F, 128-byte payloads, 32-slot game-to-network and network-to-game ring queues, monotonic sequence/session epoch fields, CRC32 integrity, status flags, and heartbeat.
The EWRAM symbol is named gCoopNetBridge; host tooling will resolve it from a generated symbol manifest in the next unit.
Initialize after heap setup and poll once per outer frame after callbacks and before PlayTimeCounter_Update; never poll from VBlank.
The first command flow is ROM_READY to SESSION_READY plus heartbeat and player/world snapshot support.
Regional progress is a fixed four-slot bridge snapshot initialized independently from legacy flags; persistent SaveBlock changes are deferred.
All C layouts use fixed-width fields, compile-time size/offset assertions, no heap allocation, and no unsafe buffer overwrite.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify SaveBlock structures, save migration, battle setup/controllers, level projection, trainer scripts/constants, maps, legacy link/RFU behavior, or build output naming.
Do not derive regional progress from FLAG_BADGE01_GET through FLAG_BADGE08_GET.
Do not hard-code an EWRAM address or implement Lua, symbol-manifest, sidecar, cloud, authentication, TLS, persistence, launcher UI, remote sprites, or battle lockstep behavior in this unit.
Do not edit any unowned file or docs/orchestration artifact.
Do not stage, commit, switch branches, fetch, push, contact remotes, or add ROM/save/savestate artifacts.

acceptance_criteria.description: The bridge ABI has explicit fixed layouts, compile-time assertions, safe queue full/empty behavior, CRC32 validation, and monotonic sequence/session fields.
Region normalization returns Hoenn, Kanto, Johto, and first-class Sevii correctly and rejects unknown regions instead of falling back to Hoenn.
WorldLocation exports widened map identity and player coordinates without serializing engine structs or using playerRegion as current location.
Regional progress has four fixed independent slots and its minimum-tier API consults only the requested battle region.
main.c initializes and polls the bridge at the audited non-VBlank hooks, with ROM_READY/SESSION_READY, heartbeat, and world-snapshot behavior implemented without heap allocation.
The modern ROM build and git diff checks pass, or any environment-only failure is reported exactly without false success.

return_when: All acceptance criteria are resolved and every required verification command has a recorded outcome.
A concrete blocker prevents further progress within the owned files and execution budget.
